facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Education planning office (GEPE) published the Anuario Estatistico da Educacao 2022/2023, whose data it says were collected through the SIGE education management information system from schools and municipal, provincial and district education offices.
The 2022/2023 education yearbook of Angola's Ministry of Education draws its figures on pupils, teachers and infrastructure from school-level data collected through SIGE.

facts.fact: Angola's Ministry of Education planning office (GEPE) says SIGE is in operation and the 2022/2023 education yearbook's data were collected through it, though the platform is "not a finished product" and structured Excel sheets were used to finish verification and indicator calculation.
